description.value:
Something in you has learned to be genuinely still.

Gift — Once per day, become unreadable for 1 minute: Perception and Sense Motive checks to read your intent, mood or truthfulness against you automatically fail. Tithe — It never fully lifts. Allies find you hard to read too, and once per session the GM may rule an ally misjudged your intent at a real cost.

cinderfall.incomplete: "Perception and Sense Motive checks to read your intent, mood or truthfulness against you automatically fail" has no rule-element equivalent: pf2e rule elements on a held/worn item modify the wielder's own rolls, not another creature's roll made against the wielder -- confirmed no selector exists for 'an opposed check targeting the item-holder' anywhere in pf2e-source (the same gap flagged on the Cinderfall equipment pass's Suppressor card, site/data/cards/equipment/weapon-upgrades/weapon-upgrades.attach-suppressor.json).
